caption:
Left your job: did you know ₹1 lakh of a ₹4 lakh PF stays locked for a year?

After a job loss you can withdraw up to 75% of your EPF balance straight away: ₹3 lakh of an illustrative ₹4 lakh.
The other 25% (₹1 lakh here) unlocks only after 12 months without a job.
Your balance keeps earning interest meanwhile. Withdrawals before 5 years of continuous service may be taxable.

Would you take the 75% out, or leave it in?

Sources: a business news site's EPF explainer (Aug 2026) and a CA news portal's report of the government's clarification (Oct 2025); the ₹ figures are our own illustrative arithmetic.
